_about: Place -> synthetic id map for the pack-era 1996 lanes (pack-1996-booth.py's own assignment; ordinary booths 1..k alphabetical per division, mobile teams and zero-venues 1001+, declaration pseudo places 8001-8004, hospitals 9001+; every id is div_id*10000 + local). The Senate lane pack (.build/map/pack-1996-senate.py) and any other 1996-era lanes read ids from here.
